sentence: This project tries to find measurable signs in the brain that show which patients with obsessive-compulsive disorder will benefit from deep brain stimulation.
This project uses computer methods on genomic data to study why mutation does not happen at the same rate across the human genome.
This project tries to find out how stress leads to anhedonia by studying glutamate function and inflammatory cytokines.
This project builds better brain imaging methods using 7T MRI to look at blood vessel damage after proton radiotherapy in children treated for brain tumors.
This project tests an automated cardiac MRI exam that could help community health centers diagnose heart failure.
This project studies how liver tissue controls fat metabolism to protect itself from the harmful effects of excess fat.
This project provides a database of linked genealogical, medical and vital records that helps researchers study cancer.
This project uses data from chronic low back pain patients to find groups at risk of poor response to treatment and later opioid use.
This project builds machine learning models that estimate the risk of severe mood episodes in young people with bipolar disorder.
This project studies how exposure to plant viruses can boost the immune system to protect against diseases like cancer.
This project studies how inflammation makes the lining of the colon cover ulcers and how the lining recovers its normal state afterward.
This project studies which genes are active in coronary plaques, using genetic material collected from balloons used to open blockages.
This project builds a map of where glioblastoma spreads along white matter tracts to guide radiation therapy for each patient.
This project tests how food insecurity, eating behavior and distress relate to weight gain during pregnancy and after birth.
This project provides microscopes and imaging services, including super-resolution microscopy and confocal microscopes, to researchers.
This project tests lipid nanoparticles that carry Cas12a ribonucleoproteins into CD4 T cells to cut out HIV DNA in infected cells.
This project uses artificial intelligence to measure and improve surgeons' skills in kidney stone removal surgeries.
This project tries to make grafts for the mouth from a patient's own stem cells so they match normal tissues.
This project studies what causes joint stiffening after total knee arthroplasty and tests treatments that stop the processes behind it.
